paragraphs.text: Mite is a creature type for cards that depict a species of small parasitic arachnids that may infest animals, plants, and stored foods and may transfer phyresis .
Mites appear prominently colorless mostly in the form of mite creature tokens , though Strev, Defector Mite is mono- white and Hemosymbic Mite is mono- green .

Mites first appeared as a creature type on colorless 1/1 tokens with toxic in Phyrexia: All Will Be One , always as Phyrexian Artifact creatures that can't block . Skrelv, Defector Mite is the first Legendary Mite in the game, from the same set, and carries all the same text and stats, alongside another ability.
A slightly earlier card, Haywire Mite from The Brothers' War had insect as creature type. As it didn't have toxic , it is unlikely to receive errata .
